record.provider: Viber Business Messages / REST Bot API

free_tier.stated: No storage quota. Same inversion as Kakao: you pass a picture URL, Viber fetches it. Max image 1 MB on iOS, 3 MB on Android, thumbnail 100 KB.

egress.terms: N/A. Viber hosts nothing for you. It requires 'The URL must have a resource with a .jpeg, .png or .gif file extension as the last path segment', i.e. it is a consumer of your public URLs.

record.tooling: viber-bot-python / raw REST POST to https://chatapi.viber.com/pa/send_message. Sender-only API.
record.chaining: Not chainable. No upload, no media_id, no listing, no retention. Structurally incapable of storing a byte.
record.limits_note: 1 MB (iOS) / 3 MB (Android) image cap applies to the file YOU host; Viber rejects larger. Business messaging also requires partner onboarding for phone-number-based sends.
record.reliability_note: Messaging API functions as a media URL consumer rather than a media hosting repository.

evidence.proved: read live: 'media | URL of the image (JPEG, PNG, non-animated GIF) | required. The URL must have a resource with a .jpeg, .png or .gif file extension as the last path segment ... Max image size: 1MB on iOS, 3MB on Android.'
